scope: Self-hosted infrastructure and lab subnets only.

_doc.self_assets: Targets the OWNER controls — laptop, own VMs, own domains, lab LAN. EXPLOITATION ALLOWED (active vuln scans, exploit modules, dictionary attacks against own assets, etc.).
_doc.external_recon_only: Third-party assets the owner has NO authorization to attack. Tools tagged category=exploit will be REFUSED. Recon (whois, dns, headers) may proceed.
_doc.engine_rule: scanner.sh resolves target → matches one of the blocks. If tool.category == exploit and matched-block.exploitation != allowed, the tool is skipped with a refusal note in the manifest.
_doc.local_audit_implicit: Local audits (no --target) run with FSROOT=/host and are implicitly 'self_assets' — exploitation is allowed because the host is the owner's machine.
